Clean this piece and repurpose the oven so employees can use the oven for personal storage. Discussed covering the top with a sheet of stainless steel - sounds like a good idea. Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-250  There are two coolers on the cook line that are holding temperature at around 45F and 56F. The small cooler holding at 45F has been opened frequently this morning and is potential keeping temperature. The long cook line cooler with drawers is holding at 56F and is definately not working properly. The cooler is filled between lunch and dinner with enough product to last 4 hours. Items are either used or discarded, so temperature of the food is not a concern. Punzak will be called to inspect the coolers and check the freon levels. A spot check will be conducted to ensure the cooler is holding temperature. Stem thermometers are available to check product temperatures.  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Foods properly cooled
findings.comment: 750-140(b)  Two thick sauces are observed in the silver door coolers by the kitchen to be in the 50-60F range. The product was discarded during the inspection and proper cooling was discussed. Cooked potentially hazardous foods shall be properly cooled from 140°F to 70°F within 2 hours and from 70°F to 41°F or below within 4 hours.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) The following food contact surfaces are soiled: 1) cutting board and knives on the bar remain unwashed and stored on the bar counter overnight; 2) espresso machine at bar; 3) ice machine baffle (right side corner is moldy); 4) prep. area utensils (tart pressers, rolling pin; slated spoons) are soiled; 5) prep. area ovens; 6) cookline microwave; and 7) cookline ovens. The baffles of the hood are also starting to show some minor signs of dust and grease accumulation. To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled: 1)fans in basement & small fan on the cookline are not being used but are quite dusty; 2)wire shelves throughout the entire facility are dusty; 3)oven drip trays are not being cleaned nightly; 4)counter below the espresso machine (bar); 5)the area to the right of the ice bin in the bar area is sticky (base of blender, not-in-use water dispenser etc); 6)bottom and insides of the beer coolers (should also be defrosted); & 7)all the containers & shelves in the prep. area. Facility, overall, is soiled & needs to be more regularly & thoroughly cleaned. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, & other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 There are mulitple soiled surfaces holding clean utensils and equipment. Make sure that shelves and cabinets are maintained clean so that items being stored on and within do not get soiled. Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750-1160 There were three roaches and drain flies observed on the glue traps in the basement. There was a large delivery of food brought into the facility today. Manager stated that he believes the roaches came into the facility today with the boxes. There are no live drain flies observed. Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 The floors throughout are soiled. The floor beneath the dishmachine is filthy. Make sure that equipment is being routinely moved so that proper mopping may occur. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors. 750-1200 The basement floor is finally chipped enough that painting needs to occur. The floor will likely be painted when the facility closes during the fall for vacation.  All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 The basement equipment needs some attention: the painted legs and shelves of equipment are beginning to peel. Some of the wood storage shelves are also peeling. The wall beneath the dismachine is soiled with splash. The edging of the mop sink should be painted and repaired. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment: 750-1280 There was observed a hat atop the ice cream maker and an apron on the meat slicer. These items were properly stored away from the food equipment during the inspection. Store employee items in the basement room that is available for belongings OR store belongings seperate and below any food and equipment. Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 There was a spray bottle of orange cleaner being stored on the meat slicer. The orange cleaner was properly stored on the floor next to the meat slicer cart during the inspection. All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food and equipment) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Clean and soiled linen segregated and properly stored.
findings.comment: 750-1380a Clean clothes and linens shall be stored in a clean place and protected from contamination until used.  Properly store all linens. 750-1380b Soiled clothes and linens shall be stored in non-absorbent containers or washable laundry bags until removed for laundering. Properly store soiled linens. There are clean and soiled linens stored throughout the facility. Some rags are observed on various shelves on the cookline. Manager stated that he couldn't tell if the rags were clean or soiled and that the night crew should be better aware of storage.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-130(b) Pans of food were observed being stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer in the basement. Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) The following food contact surfaces are soiled: 1) kitchen can opener (by two compartment sink; 2) coffee spout of waitress station is soiled; 3) steak knives in waitress station (removed for cleaning during the inspection); and 4) the lid on the bar ice bin. findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled: 1) oven drip trays; 2) fry pan storage by kitchen oven; 3) unused fan in dish room (atop the warmer); and 4) inside ovens across from two compartment sink is soiled. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 Iced tea spoons and steak knives stored in the waitress station are observed in soiled containers. During the inspection, the silverware was removed for cleaning. Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...

A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory. Clean the basement handsink.

findings.comment:
750-1200 A section of coving is pulling away from the wall beneath the dish machine. Replace the damaged coving. The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
750-1220 Floor behind equipment in the waitress station is soiled with accumulated dust and crumbs. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 The baffles above the oven are soiled. Also, there is a hole in the sink of the bar. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 690: The gasket around the unused cooler holding clean plates in the waitress area is soiled. Remove the soiled gasket or keep gasket clean. Non-food contact surfaces shall be kept in good repair.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 800: Box fans/floor fans in the basement were observed soiled. Soiled fans blow soiled air across clean surfaces and food. Clean the fans.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 800: The outsides of the white powder containers in the prep. area of the kitchen were observed soiled. Clean the exterior of these containers.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 1220: Floors under equipment (especially under the waitress ice machine and around the backdoor) are filthy. Clean and scrub the floors on a routine basis to avoid dirt and food accumulation.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 1210: The following areas need attention: 1) wall around the upstairs handsink = try to eliminate gap between mirror and sink; 2) wall on other side of handsink is dirty and damaged from garbage can constantly hitting; 3)shelf/wood trim around the mop sink is showing signs of wear and should be resealed; 4) BAR: 3-comp sink has an extra opening by the faucet. Plug the hole; 5) BASEMENT: metal floor in the walk-in is missing a square piece - replace missing flooring section so mop water and food debris do not get trapped within the gap; 6) BASEMENT: wood trim around wall and bare wood beneath equipment should be resealed when the basement is repainted. Make bare wood surfaces smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable.
